# Brief 06: Bank strategy refresh

Audience: Crestline Bank board of directors.
Decision: endorse the 2026-28 strategy that lifts return on equity from 9.1% to 12.7%.
Format: 10 slides, density balanced. Start with a cover and end with next steps.
Data: data.csv holds the peer comparison used on slides 3 and 4.

## Facts

F1: Return on equity (ROE) 2025: Crestline 9.1%; peers Harbor 12.8%, Ridgeway 11.9%, Summit 11.4%, Oakfield 10.6%, Delta 9.8%; peer median 11.4%.
F2: Cost-to-income ratio 2025: Crestline 63%; Harbor 52%, Ridgeway 54%, Summit 55%, Oakfield 58%, Delta 60%; peer median 55%.
F3: Net interest margin 2025: Crestline 2.9%; peer median 3.1%.
F4: Crestline holds $18.4B of deposits; loans grew 4% in 2025.
F5: 41% of retail customers are digitally active against 58% at peers.
F6: Small and medium enterprise (SME) loans are 22% of the loan book; peers average 31%.
F7: ROE bridge 2025 to 2028 target (percentage points): start 9.1, cost efficiency +1.4, SME growth +0.9, fee income +0.8, digital deposit mix +0.5, target 12.7.
F8: Cost efficiency plan: move the cost-to-income ratio from 63% to 55% by 2028 by closing 38 of 210 branches and automating 40% of back-office tasks.
F9: Investment required: $140M over three years: technology 70, SME build-out 35, branch transformation 25, risk and compliance 10.
F10: Capital: the common equity tier 1 ratio is 13.2% against a 12.0% internal floor.
F11: Strategic options scored on a 0-4 scale: stay the course, digital-led retail, SME focus plus efficiency (recommended), merger.
